main_text.p: magna, Dominus his diebus pudenda reuelauit: nu ditatem, ignominiam, opprobrium, & fœditatem eius, gentibus ac regnis ostendit, per electos suos Io annem Vuicleuum, Ioannem Hussium, Hieronymũ Pragensem, Thomam Thedonium, & alios. Atq; ultionem de ea capiens, contumelijs magnis per ipsos illam affecit: ut omnibus est notissimum. At serpens infidiofus, qui & suam dederat potestatem bestiæ, Apoc. 13. ad ueteres artes recurrens, nouas fraudes adinuenit, & in suis practicauit creaturis. Nouam enim hanc fucatæ reformationis faciem so phisticè induit Babylonica meretrix, ecclesiæ scilicet Romana, Satanæ synagoga, ut in omni dæmoniorum doctrinis ac superstitione mundum adhuc nutriret. Addidit illi saciei quorundam mortuorum canonizationes, ut in suis reformatis augeret simulatæ sanctitatis samam, fortiusq; per illas decipe-ret mundum Nicolaum Tolētinum Eugenius quar-tus, Augustinianus sanctum dedit, anno Domini 1446. Nicolaum quintum Franciscanis Bernardinũ Senensem, anno Domini 1451. Calixtus tertiũ Vin-centium Hispanũ Dominicanũ, anno Domini 1455. & Albertum Siculum Drepanensem Carmelitã, anno Domini 1457. ita ut eodem anno, Ioanne Pa-leonydoro teste, in Letaniis diceretur, Sancte Al-berte ora pro nobis, &c. Concefsumq; illis erat, ut foro

page.notes: Page is in the running text of a Latin Church-history book (Vuicleuum and Hussium look like the printer's spelling). The text is set in italic type for the proper names, as printed. The first line of the page is a fragment of a sentence continuing from the previous page, and the last line breaks mid-word ("foro-" continues on the next page). The mark "⸺" and the small ornaments under the text are not transcribed. Some letters in the scan are blurred; the spelling of Vuicleuum, Pragensem, Thedonium and the year numbers may be affected by print damage and should be checked against the scan. Words in italic on the page: Vuicleuum, Hussium, Pragensem, Thomam Thedonium, Hieronymũ, Apoc. 13, Babylonica, Romana, Satanæ, Nicolaum Tolētinum, Augustinianus, Franciscanis, Senensem, Calixtus, Hispanũ, Siculum, Drepanensem, Carmelitã, Ioanne, Paleonydoro, Sancte Alberte, ora pro nobis. Two spots marked by an impression mark near "reformatis" and "illas" could not be read with certainty.
